reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message to confirm I've noted 25 November as the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date. I didn't take any other action, as she asked.

I couldn't check the date against anything. Ilse can't see any Brackenwater account files or contracts, so I didn't look at them for her. #north-team has no earlier mention of Brackenwater either. The only record of this date is her message, and I told her that in the reply.

The gbrain knowledge brain also refused my search, so nothing was read from it. Its access key isn't tied to any member, so it can't tell whose access to follow. Whoever runs the gbrain server needs to fix that on their side. The brain's error message gives the command as `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. If the bot works for several people, the alternative is the `--may-act-for` setup, which names the person on each lookup. I didn't attempt that change myself.
